title: SAFE-Fire: code and frozen evaluation records

creators.name: Hade, Aya
creators.affiliation: Department of Computer Science, College of Computer Science and Information Technology, University of Sumer, Thi Qar, Iraq

creators.name: Kamil, Mustafa
creators.affiliation: Department of Computer Science, College of Computer Science and Information Technology, University of Sumer, Thi Qar, Iraq

description: Code, frozen evaluation records, trained weights and the records of every training run supporting a study of false alarm rates in indoor fire detection. Version 3.2.0 adds round 3 of the extended study, recomputed from the released score files without new training: matched budgets without the mining-development subset, in-domain D-Fire detection for every condition with one threshold rule, first-alarm latencies of every positive clip, room-trial replays, the complete overlap audit of every training set against every evaluation set, and the image fingerprints behind it.
